title: Funfinity
summary: A vibrant cultural and recreational event featuring Ganesh Vandana, Treasure Hunt, mini-games, and a DJ session with 80 participants.
description: Funfinity was a vibrant cultural and recreational event organized by our club to help students unwind while encouraging teamwork and creativity. The event featured a Ganesh Vandana, an exciting Treasure Hunt, fun mini-games, and a lively DJ session. With 80 enthusiastic participants, the ENCYPHERIST team created a memorable experience filled with energy, collaboration, and fun.

title: TECHVERSE – The Ultimate Tech Challenge
summary: Flagship technical challenge featuring technical riddles, idea presentations, and development challenges to foster innovation and teamwork.
description: We organized TECHVERSE – The Ultimate Tech Challenge as one of Encypherist's flagship technical events to foster innovation, teamwork, and problem-solving among students. The event featured technical riddles, idea presentations, and development challenges, providing participants with an opportunity to showcase their creativity, technical knowledge, and practical skills while gaining valuable hands-on experience in a competitive learning environment.

title: Donation Drive
summary: A community donation drive supporting children with intellectual disabilities, promoting social responsibility and empathy.
description: We organized a Donation Drive to support children with intellectual disabilities, promoting social responsibility and empathy among students. The team engaged the children through interactive games, music, dance, and item distribution, creating a meaningful and humbling experience for everyone involved.
location: Jivanraksha Matimand Mulanche Nivas Vidyalay, Nagpur

title: AI Pre-Hackathon Workshop & Ideation Sprint
summary: A pre-hackathon workshop bridging ideation and technical execution for aspiring AI developers.
description: The AI Pre-Hackathon Workshop & Ideation Sprint successfully brought together passionate tech enthusiasts, aspiring developers, and problem-solvers to prepare for the upcoming flagship competition. Hosted at Jhulelal Institute of Technology, the event was designed to bridge the gap between initial ideation and technical execution, giving participants a strong foundation before the main hackathon.

title: VisionX
summary: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) internal pitching event with 65 students showcasing innovative solutions.
description: We organized VisionX to bring together 65 students to showcase innovative solutions and nurture our ideas for the Smart India Hackathon (SIH) national round. It was an engaging event featuring team pitching, faculty evaluation, and strong collaboration that really helped us apply our engineering skills and receive fantastic feedback!

title: Portfolio Verse
summary: Hands-on portfolio creation competition & workshop where participants built professional PDF and web portfolios.
description: We organized Portfolio Verse, where participants created professional PDF and web portfolios to showcase their skills. With guidance from coordinators, students built their portfolios, followed by submissions, evaluations, prize distribution, and a group photo, enhancing their personal branding and career readiness.

title: AI Driven Leadership
summary: An online expert session exploring AI's role in modern management, automation, predictive tools, and prompt engineering.
description: We organized an online session, "AI Driven Leadership," for students to explore AI's role in modern management and decision-making. The speaker shared insights on automation, predictive tools, and prompt engineering, followed by an interactive Q&A session that made the event both engaging and informative.

title: Cyber Security Awareness Session
summary: An interactive awareness session on phishing, data breaches, password security, and safe digital practices.
description: We, at Encypherist, organized a Cyber Security Awareness Session to spread awareness about online safety and responsible digital practices. The session covered cyber threats such as phishing, data breaches, password security, and safe browsing through real-world examples and interactive discussions, equipping participants with practical knowledge to protect their digital identity and navigate the online world securely.

title: DISHA
summary: A community outreach programme empowering rural school students with digital literacy, AI, cyber safety, and tech skills.
description: Disha was one of Encypherist's community outreach initiatives, organized to promote digital literacy among school students from nearby villages. Through interactive sessions, hands-on activities, AI and cyber safety awareness, quizzes, and team-building exercises, our club introduced students to modern technology in an engaging way. The event reflected Encypherist's commitment to empowering young learners, encouraging curiosity, and inspiring the next generation with practical technology skills.

title: Tech Talk with Prof. Pramod Pathak (TU Dublin)
summary: Overseas higher education guidance talk featuring Prof. Pramod Pathak (Dean at TU Dublin) for 80 students.
description: ENCYPHERIST hosted an insightful Tech Talk featuring Prof. Pramod Pathak, Dean at TU Dublin, to guide 80 students on overseas higher education. The session covered Ireland's education system, scholarships, visas, and international career opportunities through an interactive Q&A.
